defs.def: how heavy sb/sth is, which can be measured in, for example, kilograms or pounds 重量；分量

ex.s: Galileo was not merely ambitious when he dropped objects of varying weights from the Leaning Tower at Pisa and timed their fall to the ground.
ex.t: 伽利略从比萨斜塔投下不同重量的物体并测算它们落地的时间，这并非仅仅出于野心。

ex.s: Next, cover the hole with the plastic sheet, securing the edges of the plastic with dirt and weighting the sheet’s center down with a rock.
ex.t: 接下来，用塑料布盖住洞，用泥土固定塑料布边缘，并在塑料布中央压一块石头使其下沉。

ex.s: Despite a weight of up to 300 kilograms, they can run at a speed of around 64 kilometers per hour and are also excellent swimmers.
ex.t: 尽管体重可达300公斤，它们却能以每小时约64公里的速度奔跑，并且还是出色的游泳健将。

ex.s: I no longer felt the weight of my clothes, or of my shoes, of my air supply, or my thick helmet, inside which my head shook like a nut in its shell.
ex.t: 我再也感觉不到衣服、鞋子、供氧设备以及厚重头盔的重量，我的头在头盔里像坚果在壳中一样晃动。

ex.s: They have an average length of about 18 cm and an average weight of about 31–41 g.
ex.t: 它们的平均体长约18厘米，平均体重约31–41克。

defs.def: the fact of being heavy 重
an object that is heavy 重物
an object used to keep sth in position or as part of a machine （用于固定某物或用作机器部件的）重体，重物
a great responsibility or worry 重任；重担；重压；压力

ex.s: As someone noted in this paper a couple of weeks ago, they eat great food and never gain weight.
ex.t: 正如几周前有人在这篇论文中指出的，它们吃的是美味食物，却从不发胖。

defs.def: importance, influence or strength 重要性；影响力；实力

ex.s: Now, I ____60____ (suppose) to feel the weight on my legs and sink my dan tian.
ex.t: 现在，我____（应该）感受双腿承受的重量，让丹田下沉。

ex.s: She is upset by her kids’ weight.
ex.t: 关于康德的论点，作者是________。

ex.s: It’s hard for writers because endings carry so much weight with readers.
ex.t: 对作家来说这很难，因为结局在读者心中分量太重。

ex.s: Ideally, you’ll end up putting more weight on the latter than the former.
ex.t: 也许你的家庭不会完全转变，但你可能对自己的一些私人空间有一定的控制权，可以进行你想要的改变。

ex.s: Anniversaries and birthdays carry even more weight in long-distance friendships.
ex.t: 虽然技术可能使日常交流成为可能，但在特殊日子付出额外的努力会有很大帮助。

ex.s: The force required to break the pancake was less than 1% of the trunk’s weight (about 100kg).
ex.t: 弄碎这块薄饼所需的力不到象鼻重量的1%（约100公斤）。

ex.s: Its weight affects its movement.
ex.t: 它的重量影响它的运动。

ex.s: He or she is the person who is feeling the weight of that awkwardness the most
ex.t: 他或她是最能感受到那份尴尬之重的人。

ex.s: But in half the cases she wore a specially designed fat suit which increased her weight to 180 pounds.
ex.t: 但在一半的情况下她穿着专门设计的增肥服使体重增加到180磅。

ex.s: To study why she could keep her weight down.
ex.t: 研究她为什么能保持体重。

ex.s: It carried more weight than it could.
ex.t: 它承载了超出自身能力的重量。

ex.s: Each has to pull their own weight.
ex.t: 每个人都必须尽自己的一份力。

ex.s: According to her research, runners hit the ground with as much as four times their body weight per step, while race walkers, who do not leave the ground, create only about 1.4 times their body weight with each step.
ex.t: 根据她的研究，跑步者每一步落地时承受的冲击高达体重的四倍，而竞走者双脚不离开地面，每一步只产生约1.4倍体重的冲击。

ex.s: They successfully lost weight.
ex.t: 他们成功减重了。

ex.s: To balance power and weight of batteries in e-planes.
ex.t: 平衡电动飞机中电池的功率和重量。

ex.s: The bags waiting there were then inflated further to take the weight of the sequoia while the transportation bags were deflated and removed from under the tree.
ex.t: 那些等候在那里的气囊随后被进一步充气，以承受巨杉的重量。

ex.s: Weight the sheet’s center down.
ex.t: 在塑料布中央压上重物使其下沉。

ex.s: Say your cat weight 5kg and eats one can of food each day.
ex.t: 假设你的猫重5公斤，每天吃掉一罐食物。

ex.s: That’s 219kg of steel-more tan a fifth of a ton and more than 40 times the cat’s weight.
ex.t: 那是219公斤钢——超过五分之一吨，是猫体重的40多倍。

defs.def: a unit or system of units by which weight is measured 重量单位；衡制
a piece of metal that is known to weigh a particular amount and is used to measure the weight of sth, or lifted by people to improve their strength and as a sport 砝码；秤砣；秤锤；杠铃片；哑铃

ex.s: If you feel one of your teammate isn’t pulling their weight, then raise your concerns in a professional way with your team coach If you think about other people’s feelings as well as your own, you’ll soon find everything works out.
ex.t: 如果你觉得某位队友没有尽到本分，那就以专业的方式向教练提出你的顾虑。如果你既考虑别人的感受也考虑自己的，你很快就会发现一切都会好起来。

ex.s: It is perhaps the longest species of monkey and also one of the heaviest: a male’s body length can reach 50–115 cm, with a tail length of 45–84 cm, while it can weigh 21– 45 kg; a female’s body weight can range 12–25 kg.
ex.t: 它或许是最长的猴类，也是最重的之一：雄性体长可达50–115厘米，尾长45–84厘米，体重可达21–45公斤；雌性体重在12–25公斤之间。

defs.def: to attach a weight to sth in order to keep it in the right position or make it heavier 在 … 上加重量；使负重；（用重物）固定
to give different values to things to show how important you think each of them is compared with the others 使加权

ex.s: You and your partner will probably have different skills. ___40___ Over time, both of you will benefit — your partner will be able to lift more weights and you will become more physically fit.
ex.t: 你和你的伴侣可能有不同的技能。___40___随着时间的推移，你们双方都会受益——你的伴侣将能够举起更重的重量，而你将变得更加健康。
